scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build --workspace functions
scripts.emulators: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-tra-cuu --only firestore,functions
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-tra-cuu --only firestore,functions "node scripts/test-emulator.mjs"
scripts.deploy: node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && npm run build && firebase deploy --only firestore,functions,hosting
